CustomField.description: Since the Opportunity is now locked for Sales Profiles at Stages 6 and 7, sales still needs to update field “Up-Sell Detail” in stages 6 and 7 to log billing details. This allows them to communicate to Commissions via this field. “Up-sell Detail” Chatter Action allows bypassing the validation and is able to only update this field.[Case# 02497355].
CustomField.label: Bypass Validation
